task: Build the Firefox MV3 extension 'Form Field Find & Replace' per SPEC.md: manifest + popup shell, content-script field collection/filtering, replacement path with native-setter and format validation/rollback, regex backreferences and match preview, chunked loop with progress/cancel at scale, shadow DOM and iframe traversal, undo, and final tests/lint/security-audit. Step 0 security pass is already complete.

phases.name: Manifest and Popup Shell
phases.description: Create manifest.json (MV3 event page, minimal permissions) and the full popup/{popup.html,popup.js,popup.css} UI shell with persistence, before any content-script logic exists.
acceptance_criteria: manifest.json exists, is valid JSON, manifest_version === 3, browser_specific_settings.gecko.id === 'find-replace@example.local', browser_specific_settings.gecko.strict_min_version === '115.0'
manifest.json permissions array is exactly ['activeTab','scripting','storage'] with no host_permissions entries
manifest.json declares background.scripts (event page) and does NOT declare background.service_worker

popup/popup.html contains: find input, replace input, checkboxes for match case / whole word / regular expression / include iframes, a collapsible 'Field types' section with the four groups (Text: text/search/url/tel/email; Numeric and date: number/date/datetime-local/month/week/time; Multi-line: textarea; Rich text: contenteditable) with select-all/select-none links, buttons Count matches/Replace all/Undo last replace/Cancel, a status line element, and a progress bar element
Field-type default checked state in popup.html/popup.js matches spec: Text, Multi-line, Rich text checked by default; Numeric and date unchecked by default

popup/popup.js persists find/replace strings, option checkbox states, and field-type selections to storage.local on change and restores them on popup load, verifiable by reading the storage.local.set/get call sites
popup/popup.css exists, declares a system font stack, and includes a prefers-color-scheme media query; no external framework files are referenced
Running `npx web-ext lint` from the repo root reports zero errors (warnings acceptable at this stage); command output is captured and reviewable

phases.name: Field Collection, Filtering and Test Fixtures
phases.description: Implement content/find-replace.js's collectFields(root) single-pass generator with always-skip rules and field-type filtering wired to a counting-only 'count' message; create test/fixture.html and test/fixture-bulk.html (5,000 seeded inputs) plus a Node+Playwright test harness scaffold with an initial passing test.
acceptance_criteria: content/find-replace.js implements collectFields(root) as a single-pass walk producing flat descriptors {el, kind, type, originalValue}, with no getComputedStyle call in the main walk except as a documented fallback when offsetParent is null
Missing or unrecognized input type attributes resolve to 'text' and the resolved type is exposed on the descriptor

Always-skip rules are implemented as identifiable code branches: type password/hidden/file, disabled, readonly, aria-readonly='true', and zero-rendered-size (offsetParent === null and position is not fixed)
Field-type filtering applies the popup's four checkbox groups to the collected array before computing the count returned to the popup
test/fixture.html exists containing: a form with text input, email input, textarea, and a password field; a contenteditable div with nested <b> and <span>; a disabled input; a readonly input

test/fixture-bulk.html exists, generates exactly 5,000 input elements via an inline script on page load, and states a known seeded match count as an explicit constant (JS comment or exported value) in the file
package.json exists at the repo root with a 'test' script and Playwright declared as a devDependency
Running `npm test` executes and passes at least one test opening test/fixture.html and asserting collectFields returns the expected non-skipped field count, producing test-results/gtest-results.xml

phases.name: Replacement Path: Native Setter and Format Validation
phases.description: Implement the shared count/replace matcher, native-setter-plus-events value assignment for input/textarea, contenteditable text-node replacement, and the format read-back/rollback for number/date/datetime-local/month/week/time fields; extend message handling and fixture.html accordingly.
acceptance_criteria: A single matcher function is used by both the count code path and the replace code path (same function referenced from both call sites)

Plain mode escapes regex metacharacters in the needle before building the RegExp; whole-word mode wraps the pattern in \b...\b; regex mode compiles the user pattern in try/catch and returns the error message via the response's error field rather than throwing
Input/textarea value assignment uses Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(proto,'value').set.call(el,newValue) followed by dispatching InputEvent('input',{bubbles:true}) and Event('change',{bubbles:true})
contenteditable replacement walks text nodes and sets nodeValue per node (no innerHTML reassignment), then dispatches a bubbling input event on the host element

For number/date/datetime-local/month/week/time fields, code reads el.value back after assignment; on mismatch it restores the original value and records the field as skipped with reason 'invalid format', never leaving the field blank as a side effect
The runtime message listener validates message.action is one of count/replace/undo/cancel and validates presence of find/options/fieldTypes before acting, ignoring malformed messages

test/fixture.html additionally contains one each of number, date, datetime-local, month, week, time inputs prefilled with valid values, plus a controlled-input widget that reverts its value unless a real input event fires

`npm test` passes two new tests: (1) a replace against the controlled-input widget updates its displayed value via the native-setter path, (2) a date-field replace that produces an invalid value is rolled back so el.value equals the original value (not empty)

phases.name: Regex Backreferences and Match Preview
phases.description: Add full substitution-grammar support in regex mode, literal-dollar escaping in plain mode, backreference validation against declared groups, and a live first-match preview in the popup.
acceptance_criteria: In plain (non-regex) mode, any '$' in the replacement string is escaped to '$$' before being passed to String.prototype.replace, verified by a test where finding/replacing literal text containing '$5.00' produces exactly '$5.00' unmangled
Regex mode supports $1-$99, $<name> with named capture groups, $&, $`, $', and $$, each covered by at least one passing test

Before running a replace, code checks every $N and $<name> token in the replacement string against the compiled pattern's actual group count/names; on a mismatch the popup status line shows a warning and the replace run is blocked until acknowledged or corrected, verifiable via a distinct warning/error code path that does not invoke the replace loop
popup.js computes and displays a live preview of the first match's substitution result as the user types, using the same shared matcher function, in a dedicated preview UI element

`npm test` passes new tests covering literal-dollar escaping, each backreference token type, the group-mismatch warning path, and the live preview computation, producing an updated test-results/gtest-results.xml

phases.name: Chunked Loop with Progress, Cancel and Scale Validation
phases.description: Implement the ~200-field chunked processing loop with event-loop yields, cancellation, throttled progress messaging, and wall-time reporting; validate directly against test/fixture-bulk.html's 5,000 fields.
acceptance_criteria: A chunk-size constant of approximately 200 is defined in code with a comment noting it was tuned against fixture-bulk.html

The main replace loop is a plain indexed for loop over the pre-collected flat field array with no Array.prototype.map/recursion over the field list, and the RegExp is constructed once outside the loop with lastIndex reset per field
After each chunk, a `{type:'progress', done, total, replaced, skipped}` message is posted to the popup, throttled in code to at most ~10 posts per second
A module-level `cancelled` boolean is checked at the top of each chunk; setting it stops further chunk processing while leaving already-replaced fields in place
The final status message includes total wall-clock time in milliseconds

Undo snapshots are appended to a flat array during the same replace pass (not a second DOM walk), capped at 50,000 entries; when the collected field count would exceed the cap, undo is disabled for that run and the popup warns the user before Replace all begins

`npm test` includes a fixture-bulk.html-driven test suite asserting: (a) a full replace run reports the pre-seeded match count documented in phase-2's fixture-bulk.html constant, (b) received progress messages show monotonically increasing `done` values, (c) triggering cancel mid-run halts further replacements and reports a partial replaced count less than total — all producing test-results/gtest-results.xml

perf-benchmarks records the wall-clock time of a full 5,000-field replace run and confirms no single blocking task exceeds one chunk's expected processing time, with the measurement documented in benchmark output

phases.name: Shadow DOM and Iframe Traversal
phases.description: Generalize collectFields into one generator handling document, open shadow roots, and same-origin iframe documents uniformly, skipping closed shadow roots and cross-origin iframes quietly; extend fixture.html with the corresponding cases.
acceptance_criteria: collectFields(root) recurses into every open shadowRoot encountered, and (when include-iframes is set) into same-origin iframe documents, via one shared generator implementation with no separate duplicated walk function for shadow-root vs iframe traversal
Cross-origin iframe access is wrapped in try/catch and skipped without throwing or surfacing any error to the popup UI

test/fixture.html now also contains: a field inside an open shadow root, a same-origin iframe containing its own form field, and a cross-origin iframe reference that would raise a SecurityError on access

`npm test` passes tests confirming: a shadow-root field is found and correctly replaced; a same-origin iframe field is found and replaced only when include-iframes is checked and is not found when unchecked; the cross-origin iframe causes no thrown error and does not abort the run
Closed shadow roots (if present in fixture.html) are confirmed unreachable/skipped without error

phases.name: Undo
phases.description: Implement one-level undo restoring all touched elements' original values through the native-setter-plus-events path, wired to the popup's Undo button, keeping undo valid after a cancelled run.
acceptance_criteria: A module-level snapshot store of {el, value} entries is populated before the first mutation of each replace run and is what the undo action restores from; starting a new replace run replaces the previous snapshot (one level only)
Undo restores values via the same native-setter-plus-input/change-event path used by replace, not a direct .value assignment
After a cancelled run, invoking undo restores exactly the fields changed before cancellation, not the full originally-collected set
popup.js enables 'Undo last replace' only after a completed or cancelled replace run with at least one changed field, and disables it again after undo is invoked
Popup UI text states that one level of undo is supported

`npm test` passes tests for: full-run undo restores all changed fields; partial (cancelled) run undo restores only the changed subset; Undo button enabled/disabled state transitions across a run/cancel/undo cycle

phases.name: Tests, Lint and Security Audit Finalization
phases.description: Complete remaining deliverables, run the full automated suite, web-ext lint, and security-audit.sh clean, and finalize README/CLAUDE.md documentation.
acceptance_criteria: All Step 3 deliverables exist at their expected paths: manifest.json, background.js, popup/popup.html, popup/popup.js, popup/popup.css, content/find-replace.js, test/fixture.html, test/fixture-bulk.html, security-audit.sh, .claude-security.json, CLAUDE.md, README.md

security-audit.sh is executable and implements: credential/secret grep scan, .git directory permission check, manifest.json permission review against .claude-security.json's allowlist, a scan for eval/innerHTML/Function( usage under popup/ and content/, and exits non-zero when any finding occurs
.claude-security.json defines scan paths, ignore globs, severity thresholds, and a required-manifest-permissions allowlist matching activeTab/scripting/storage

README.md documents: loading the extension via about:debugging -> This Firefox -> Load Temporary Add-on -> manifest.json; how to run the test fixtures and `npm test`; known limitations (closed shadow roots, cross-origin iframes, canvas/CodeMirror-style editors); and recorded wall-clock timing observations from the fixture-bulk.html 5,000-field run
Running `./security-audit.sh` against the working tree exits 0 with no findings
Running `npx web-ext lint` against the extension root reports zero errors
Running `npm test` executes the complete suite accumulated across all phases and passes 100%, producing test-results/gtest-results.xml with zero failing tests
